name: golist-v2
description: Quickly browse a collection of links or files with one short URL.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix functions install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix functions run lint
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project golist-v2-test "vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.js"
scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:frontend
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && firebase hosting:channel:deploy preview --expires 7d
